theorem lg_target : StrictMonoOn Int.natAbs (Set.Ici 0) := by
  constructor
  intro a
  intro b
  intro h
  have h_a : a ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by exact b
  have h_b : b ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by exact h
  cases h_a with a_nonneg
  cases h_b with b_nonneg
  apply Int.natAbs_strictMono_on_Ici
  exact h
